task:
Create RBAC resources in namespace 'project-hamster':

  1. Create namespace 'project-hamster' if it does not exist.

  2. Create a ServiceAccount named 'processor' in namespace 'project-hamster'.

  3. Create a Role named 'processor' in namespace 'project-hamster' that allows:
     - create on secrets
     - create on configmaps
     (No other permissions — not get, list, watch, delete, etc.)

  4. Create a RoleBinding named 'processor' in namespace 'project-hamster' that:
     - Binds the Role 'processor'
     - To the ServiceAccount 'processor' in the same namespace

Validate:
  kubectl auth can-i create secrets \
    --as=system:serviceaccount:project-hamster:processor \
    -n project-hamster
  # Expected: yes

  kubectl auth can-i get secrets \
    --as=system:serviceaccount:project-hamster:processor \
    -n project-hamster
  # Expected: no
detailed_hints: Imperative: kubectl create rolebinding processor --role=processor --serviceaccount=project-hamster:processor -n project-hamster
Verify: kubectl auth can-i create secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:project-hamster:processor -n project-hamster

validators.command: kubectl get serviceaccount processor -n project-hamster -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'
kubectl get role processor -n project-hamster -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'
kubectl get role processor -n project-hamster -o jsonpath='{.rules[*].verbs}'
kubectl get role processor -n project-hamster -o jsonpath='{.rules[*].resources}'
kubectl get rolebinding processor -n project-hamster -o jsonpath='{.subjects[0].name}'
kubectl auth can-i create secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:project-hamster:processor -n project-hamster
